changes: feat: New folder layout: the code lives in ~/.local/src/aw-shell and ~/.config/aw-shell holds only your settings. Updating moves your install for you and keeps your settings; nothing is deleted
feat: Kanban board and pins move to ~/.local/share/aw-shell, calculator history to ~/.local/state/aw-shell, and session files out of the shared /tmp. They move over on their own at startup
feat: Change the look without editing the code: ~/.config/aw-shell/styles/user.css loads after the built-in styles
fix: Fresh installs follow the wallpaper's colors again; applying settings had stopped setting up matugen in 1.0.2
fix: The installer builds the system tray library (Gray) itself; its AUR package couldn't install, which left some installs without a tray
fix: Caffeine starts its idle inhibitor with the shell's own Python, so it works without the libraries installed system-wide
update: PyGObject 3.58, the version Arch ships, with a fix in Aw-Shell's copy of fabric; unused packages dropped (Zed Sans font, vte3, unzip, pyopengl)
update: uninstall.sh asks before deleting your settings, kanban board and pins; an AUR package is on the way
fix: Screenshots no longer say "Screenshot Aborted" when the capture worked, and the clipboard and notification always get the complete image
fix: Opening Settings no longer re-applies your color theme and wallpaper in the background or resets the color scheme to Tonal Spot
fix: Web requests no longer trust the compromised eMudhra certificate authorities
update: Pillow 13 (39 security fixes), PySide6 6.12 and other updated packages
update: New README screenshots; the screenshot script is covered by tests and local test runs work with rootless Docker
fix: Bar metrics, battery and network speed stop updating when their bar goes away (e.g. a monitor is unplugged), instead of writing to removed widgets
update: README has a table of contents, lists the supported systems and puts installation first
fix: Notifications that an app withdraws now disappear right away instead of staying until they time out
fix: Wallpapers with capitals or spaces in their name no longer stop the wallpaper list from loading, and no longer show up twice
fix: The launcher calculator handles exp(), factorials (5!) and scientific notation (1e3)
fix: Settings opens from the launcher and on first start even when the system Python lacks the shell's dependencies
fix: The network applet keeps updating while you're offline
fix: The update window opens at a size that fits the screen it's on
perf: The shell no longer loads the Qt settings libraries at startup, using less memory
update: Much larger test suite, including real-GTK tests that catch errors GTK only logs; the README explains how to run it
feat: A recording indicator appears in the bar while the screen recorder runs, showing the elapsed time; click it to stop
fix: Screen recording works on multi-GPU setups by falling back to the desktop portal, and stopping waits for the file to finish saving
fix: Settings window opens at a size that fits the screen it's on and floats instead of filling the screen
update: README lists what has changed since Ax-Shell
fix: Automated tests pass again after 1.2.9 (no changes to the shell itself)
fix: Tray icons (Discord, Sunshine, ...) show on every monitor's bar, not only the first one
fix: Bar, notch, dock and overview use the right monitor's size and focus when screens connect in a different order than they're arranged
feat: Notifications appear on the monitor you're using; at startup, the main monitor (the one holding workspace 1)
fix: Opening the notch no longer stalls for 2 seconds when Hyprland doesn't answer
update: Removed the non-working toggle_launcher.py and toggle_overview.py scripts
feat: Updater shows each change on its own row with a theme-colored type tag
fix: Updater reads version info through the GitHub API, so new releases show up within a minute
update: Changelog now includes the 1.1.0 and 1.2.0 releases
feat: Color scheme changes apply immediately, and the chosen scheme is remembered
feat: Full theme palette is written to config/colors.json so other tools (e.g. matuwrap terminal colors) follow aw-shell's theme
feat: Updater changelog is grouped by version with new versions marked; --preview opens it safely for inspection
fix: Closing a window from the overview focuses it when the app asks for confirmation
update: Fabric and other dependencies updated
feat: Window border colors follow a new wallpaper instantly, no Hyprland reload needed
fix: Dashboard microphone icon shows again
fix: Shell no longer keeps a CPU core and upowerd busy (mouse battery update loop)
perf: Notch occlusion is event-driven over Hyprland IPC and checks each monitor separately
perf: Toolbox status checks run in-process instead of spawning pgrep and scripts every 2s
feat: Headset battery ring via headsetcontrol; mouse battery ring shows a mouse icon
fix: Hover tooltips show again (repeated tooltip updates kept cancelling them)
fix: Game mode works on Hyprland 0.56 and Lua configs
update: Default audio mixer shortcut is now SUPER+X (existing configs keep their key)
fix: Keybinds left unset no longer generate empty SUPER binds
fix: Connecting to a saved Wi-Fi network reuses its profile instead of creating a duplicate
fix: Wallpaper thumbnails refresh when a wallpaper's content changes
fix: Caffeine works again (pywayland 0.4.19) and shows its real state
feat: "Suspend when idle" option in Settings → Hyprland Integration
fix: Only one hypridle runs after Apply, so idle timers no longer fire twice
fix: Settings keep "all monitors" instead of saving every monitor by name
fix: Scrolling the settings page no longer changes spin boxes, dropdowns or sliders
fix: Overview uses Hyprland Lua dispatch syntax
fix: Metrics no longer crash without UPower
fix: Default wallpaper points to an existing file, broken ~/.current.wall is replaced
test: Real-GTK test suite in Docker (headless sway), coverage badge
feat: "Lock After Idle" setting, hypridle.conf is now generated from it
update: Hyprland Lua config: hyprland.lua dofile() line and hl.dsp dispatch
fix: Rounded corners on all monitors
fix: Rewrote Bluetooth on BlueZ D-Bus + bluetoothctl (pairing, trust, error feedback)
update: Hyprland config migrated to Lua (hyprland.lua + generated aw-shell.lua), requires Hyprland 0.56.2+
update: Matugen also writes Lua colors (colors.lua) for the Hyprland config
fix: Wallpaper daemon (awww) no longer crashes at login
feat: Logitech mouse battery ring in the bar
feat: Lua config for Hyprland 0.55+ (first step of the Lua migration)
fix: Weather widget stays hidden until weather data is available
fix: Valid rgba syntax for the window shadow color
test: Weather tests and higher coverage; CI runs tests with Glaze and headless GL
update: Dependencies updated
update: Added regression tests for the latest breaking changes, updated to use .venv-python
hotfix: Update Glaze version with matugen fix
hotfix: Matugen 4.0.0 breaking api change, json decode changes
test: Comprehensive test suite - 362 tests, 94% coverage
cleanup: Removed dead GTK settings modules (about, appearance, keybindings, system, window)
refactor: Major codebase refactoring for maintainability
refactor: Extracted Signal class to utils/signal.py
refactor: Created BaseSlider class hierarchy for controls
refactor: Added layout utilities module
fork: Rebranded from Ax-Shell to Aw-Shell
